# `encode`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
encode(str, charset)
```

Encodes the first argument using the second argument character set. If either argument is null, the result will also be null.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT encode('abc', 'utf-8');
```

Result:

```text
abc
```
